sections.label: Intro
sections.intent: Fragile melodic motif on upper strings, sparse arpeggio, leave space

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.intent: Main conversational vocal-like phrase, rests between phrases

sections.label: Chorus 1
sections.intent: Open chord arpeggios with melodic top note, slightly fuller but still intimate

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.intent: Similar melody with small variation at phrase ends, more resonance

sections.label: Bridge
sections.intent: Step back to sparse harmonics, let cello lead, play gentle sustained notes

sections.label: Final Chorus
sections.intent: Melody embellished with neighbor tones and harmonized by counterline, strumming pattern with rests

tracks.name: Warm Keys
tracks.instrument_hint: soft electric piano or felt piano

tracks.name: Brush Percussion
tracks.instrument_hint: brush kit or drum map (kick, snare, hi-hat)
